## SV genotyping from read depth (chr10:9,102,316-9,108,300)

Read depth in the ~5.9 kb primary-only gap region, normalised by flanking anchor
depth, gives a per-individual proxy for which haplotype(s) they carry at the
structural variant locus:
  - `sv_ratio ≈ 1.0`  →  primary/primary  (0|0)
  - `sv_ratio ≈ 0.5`  →  heterozygous      (0|1)
  - `sv_ratio ≈ 0.0`  →  alt/alt           (1|1)

Run on the cluster first:
```bash
# On the cluster – adjust BAM_DIR to your bam directory
bash analysis/pipeline/8_sv_depth_genotype.sh /path/to/bam_dir \
     reports/structural_variant/chr10_9064949_9205154/sv_depth.tsv
```

```{r sv-depth-load}
pheno <- read.table(
  file.path(data_path, "dfs", "pheno.txt"), header=T) %>%
  dplyr::select(IID, FID, hatch_date)

sv_per_sample_dir <- file.path(
  reports_path,
  "structural_variant", "sv_depth_per_sample"
)

sv_files <- list.files(sv_per_sample_dir, pattern = "\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot("No per-sample TSV files found" = length(sv_files) > 0)

sv <- lapply(sv_files, read.table, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", na.strings = "NA") %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  left_join(pheno, by = c("sample" = "IID")) %>%
  left_join(sex,   by = c("sample" = "IID"))

cat(sprintf("Loaded %d samples from %s\n", nrow(sv), sv_per_sample_dir))
```

```{r sv-depth-classify}
focal_samples <- c(
  "F10_1", "F10_2", "F10_3", "F10_5", "F10_9", "F105_7", "F105_8",
  "F110_1", "F116_5", "F116_6", "F116_9", "F118_19", "F118_2", "F118_20",
  "F118_3", "F118_9", "F126_13", "F126_14", "F126_2", "F126_5", "F135_11",
  "F135_16", "F135_17", "F135_19", "F135_3", "F138_1", "F138_11", "F138_12",
  "F138_6", "F140_11", "F140_13", "F140_14", "F140_18", "F140_20", "F145_13",
  "F145_15", "F145_16", "F145_19", "F145_3", "F148_10", "F148_11", "F148_12",
  "F148_13", "F148_4", "F15_14", "F15_4", "F157_1", "F157_13", "F157_6",
  "F159_2", "F159_3", "F159_4", "F159_9", "F165_3", "F170_1", "F170_14",
  "F170_18", "F170_5", "F180_11", "F180_2", "F180_3", "F180_4", "F20_2",
  "F23_11", "F23_18", "F23_2", "F25_11", "F25_12", "F25_3", "F25_4",
  "F37_11", "F38_10", "F42_16", "F44_12", "F44_14", "F44_4", "F44_5",
  "F44_8", "F46_11", "F46_13", "F50_16", "F50_20", "F50_3", "F56_11",
  "F56_9", "F57_1", "F57_3", "F63_4", "F63_6", "F63_9", "F64_1",
  "F64_11", "F64_3", "F64_6", "F67_10", "F67_11", "F69_19", "F69_20",
  "F81_2", "F81_5", "F86_20", "F86_9", "F95_12", "F95_14", "F95_3", "F95_4"
)

# ── Classify SV genotype from depth ratio ──────────────────────────────────
# Boundaries between genotype classes (adjust if needed after inspection)
HOM_ALT_UPPER  <- 0.20   # ratio < 0.20  → alt/alt
HOM_PRIM_LOWER <- 0.80   # ratio > 0.80  → primary/primary
# between 0.20 and 0.80  → heterozygous

sv <- sv %>%
  mutate(
    sv_genotype = case_when(
      is.na(sv_ratio)            ~ NA_character_,
      sv_ratio < HOM_ALT_UPPER   ~ "alt/alt",
      sv_ratio > HOM_PRIM_LOWER  ~ "prim/prim",
      TRUE                       ~ "het"
    ),
    sv_genotype = factor(sv_genotype, levels = c("prim/prim", "het", "alt/alt"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(is_focal = sample %in% focal_samples)

# Summary table
sv %>%
  count(sv_genotype) %>%
  mutate(freq = n / sum(n))
```

```{r sv-depth-plot}
pal_sv <- c("prim/prim" = "#3A78B5", "het" = "#9B59B6", "alt/alt" = "#E07A1E")

# ── 1. Histogram of sv_ratio coloured by inferred genotype ────────────────
p_hist <- sv %>%
  filter(!is.na(sv_ratio)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sv_ratio, fill = sv_genotype)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(HOM_ALT_UPPER, HOM_PRIM_LOWER),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_sv, na.value = "grey70",
                    name = "SV genotype") +
  labs(
    title    = "SV depth ratio distribution",
    subtitle = "chr10:9,102,316–9,108,300 depth / flanking anchor depth",
    x        = "Depth ratio (SV inner / anchor)",
    y        = "Number of individuals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p_hist

# Organic palette
pal_org <- c(
  "A" = "#2a8294",
  "B" = "#d7c83b",
  "C" = "#a94347",
  "D" = "#727642"
)

# Shared theme
theme_org <- theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey35"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Panel A: mean +/- 95% CI + raw data
p_pheno <- sv %>%
  filter(!is.na(sv_ratio), !is.na(hatch_date)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sv_genotype, y = hatch_date, color = sv_genotype)) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.06,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_normal,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.12,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "prim/prim" = "#2a8294",
      "het" = "#d7c83b"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Hatch date by SV genotype",
    subtitle = "Mean with 95% CI and raw observations",
    x = "\nSV genotype",
    y = "Hatch date (days)\n"
  ) +
  theme_org

# Panel B: mean +/- 95% CI + raw data
p_focal <- sv %>%
  filter(!is.na(sv_ratio), !is.na(hatch_date)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = is_focal, y = sv_ratio, color = is_focal)) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.06,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_normal,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.12,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "FALSE" = "#727642",
      "TRUE" = "#a94347"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "SV ratio by focal status",
    subtitle = "Mean with 95% CI and raw observations",
    x = "\nFocal individual",
    y = "SV ratio\n"
  ) +
  theme_org
# Panel C: clipped reads with mean ±95% CI + raw data
p_clips <- sv %>%
  filter(!is.na(sv_genotype)) %>%
  mutate(clipped_total = clipped_BP1 + clipped_BP2) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sv_genotype, y = clipped_total, color = sv_genotype)) +

  # raw observations
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.06,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  # mean point
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3,
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  # 95% CI
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_normal,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.12,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "prim/prim" = "#2a8294",
      "het" = "#d7c83b"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Soft-clipped reads at SV breakpoints",
    subtitle = "Mean clipped reads by genotype with 95% CI",
    x = "\nSV genotype",
    y = "Total clipped reads (BP1 + BP2)\n"
  ) +

  theme_org

# Combine all three panels
(p_focal + p_pheno + p_clips) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Structural variant associations with phenotype",
    subtitle = "Mean estimates, 95% confidence intervals, and raw observations",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        family = "roboto_condensed",
        face = "bold",
        size = 16
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        family = "roboto_condensed",
        size = 11
      )
    )
  ) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    )
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(reports_path, "structural_variant", "sv_hatchdate_focal.png"),
  width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

# contingency table
tab_sv <- sv %>%
  filter(!is.na(is_focal), !is.na(sv_genotype)) %>%
  count(is_focal, sv_genotype) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sv_genotype,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

tab_sv
```

```{r sv-depth-stats}
# ── Linear model: hatch date ~ sv genotype (controlling for family) ────────
m_sv <- lmer(hatch_date ~ sv_genotype + (1 | FID), data = sv)
summary(m_sv)

# ANOVA-style test
anova(m_sv)

# Pairwise contrasts
library(emmeans)
emm <- emmeans(m_sv, ~ sv_genotype)
pairs(emm, adjust = "bonferroni")
```
